About

A place to think
with precision.

Independent research into how intelligent systems change regulated work, and the human judgement that remains essential.

A space for independent thinking

AI Legal explores artificial intelligence, law, governance and the design of intelligent systems through essays, research notes and experimental prototypes.

The work sits where machine-learning systems meet the regulated, high-stakes work of legal, health, insurance and financial services. The aim is to notice shared patterns, understand practical constraints and test ideas in public.

The person behind the work

AI Legal is edited by Milos Kresojevic. His work spans enterprise technology and architecture, with a longstanding interest in AI’s role in law and governance.

Research with clear boundaries

The essays are arguments to examine, not advice to rely on in an individual matter. The lab describes research artefacts, rather than commercial tools or legal services.

AI Legal does not offer legal representation through this website. Using the site or contacting us does not create an attorney–client relationship.
